Repair and extend the Eywa offline campaign toolkit in `/workspace/project`.
It must compile typed model layouts, recover symbolic tests, and prepare replay.
Work inside the supplied Python package; the current pipeline is incomplete.
The type visitors, expression AST, graph composer, and runner need integration.
Read `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md` for every input, output, and semantic boundary.
Repair aggregate numbering and strict test decoding across nested named types.
Support scoped validation, exact arithmetic, and deterministic state preambles.
Model-return values are witnesses; they do not define the identity of a test.
Deliver the complete project tree, including `campaign_cli.py` and `src/`.
All regular auxiliary files are allowed within the published submission bounds.
The evaluator runs `python3 -I -B /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py`.
The program reads one JSON campaign and writes its complete JSON certificate.
No network calls, model service, Docker daemon, or symbolic engine is required.
Python 3.11.14 and its standard library provide all required dependencies.
Develop with `python3 /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < /workspace/examples/smoke.input.json`.
Run `python3 /workspace/public_check.py /workspace/project` for public sanity.
The public check does not cover the full documented domain or maximum scale.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
Everything is complete and validated. Final summary of the delivered work:

**Project tree** (`/workspace/project`, 49 KB, 16 entries — within bounds, all regular files):
- **`campaign_cli.py`** — strict JSON framing: duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid UTF-8, malformed/trailing JSON, and oversize input produce exactly `{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}` with exit zero; otherwise reads one campaign and writes its complete certificate
- **`src/eywa/ast.py`** — named types with transparent alias resolution, typed predicate AST with exact evaluation (modulo 2^bits add/sub, left-to-right short-circuiting, deep eq/ne, lexical `all` shadowing, literal-NUL constants)
- **`src/eywa/oracles.py`** — aggregate numbering per the MainBuilder convention (composites reserve IDs but no objects, strings as buffer + N char objects, aliases transparent), dependency-before-user declaration postorder, and the inverse reader (NUL string recovery, leaf range checks)
- **`src/eywa/wire.py`** — strict canonical base64 and KTEST v3 decoding (argument bounds, canonical `xN` names, no trailing bytes)
- **`src/eywa/composer.py`** — call/pipe prerequisite DAG, root-scoped min-lexicographic compile order, transitive composed filter-application expansion
- **`src/eywa/state.py`** — exact (sum of costs, command count, lexicographic) minimum preambles via tight-edge DAG DP with interned command-sequence tries
- **`src/eywa/run.py`** — typed corpus identity (JSON type identity preserved; model results excluded)
- **`src/eywa/offline.py`** — pipeline integration: per-run inventory/leaf/flag validation preceding FILTERED/UNREACHABLE/dedup, `bad_input` attestation, and corpus assembly

**Validation performed**: both public fixtures match exactly; 13 test programs covering the full documented domain (layout, recovery, attestation precedence, filter composition, guards, match grammar, framing); randomized differentials — state preparation vs brute force on 400 random machines, pattern engine vs Python `re` on 5000 cases, layout/recovery roundtrip on 300 random type graphs; and four maximum-scale stress runs (2048 runs × long preambles, per-run distinct guard sets, 2M KTEST objects, 4095 filter applications) all finishing well inside the 120 s budget.
